notes.title: Game update
notes.content: [p]The main change in this first major post-release update is a new user interface style based on player feedback.[/p][p]Various minor fixes have also been made to improve gameplay.[/p]

tags.feature: The main change in this first major post-release update is a new user interface style based on player feedback.

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content: [p]Over the past few weeks, changes have been made to a variety of aspects of the game - mechanics have been changed and simplified, balance has been adjusted, bugs have been fixed, and graphics have been improved.[/p][p]Here are some of them:[/p][h3]New starting mission[/h3][p]A prologue has been added to the first mission, splitting the tutorial into two parts and adding the necessary story context.[/p][h3]Achievements[/h3][p]Achievements have been added to the demo and the full version of the game. Achievements take into account the player's past progress and will be counted automatically if the player has already fulfilled the conditions required for them.[/p][h3]In-game encyclopedia[/h3][p]Now the player can always view help on game mechanics, tutorial messages, or a brief summary of the game's plot events.[/p]

tags.feature: A prologue has been added to the first mission, splitting the tutorial into two parts and adding the necessary story context.

Achievements have been added to the demo and the full version of the game. Achievements take into account the player's past progress and will be counted automatically if the player has already fulfilled the conditions required for them.
Now the player can always view help on game mechanics, tutorial messages, or a brief summary of the game's plot events.

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content: [p]At the moment, all the content planned for the full version is ready - all 22 missions, which make up the game's 3 acts. But as work on the game progresses, the first act available in the demo version also changes.[/p][p]From bug fixes, AI improvements, and model updates to the addition of new content, the demo reflects the current state of the full version.[/p]
